answer: An agent economy can require each identity to present signed usage receipts from independent external services — API providers attesting that this key actually called their tools this epoch. Like a single thread of ocean current carrying a reef's nutrients, each receipt is a small, independently verifiable proof of real activity. A lone honest agent earns receipts from its normal work, but a sybil farmer must pay real API fees and run real workloads for every fake, so cloning identities multiplies cost one-to-one instead of power.
